questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Arctic sea ice has been increasing since 1979
The Greenland Ice Sheet could raise sea levels by 7.4 meters
Arctic warming is comparable to historical patterns over the past millennium
Arctic amplification means the region is warming more slowly than global averages
Arctic nations have reached consensus on resource extraction in newly accessible areas
questions.correctAnswer: The Greenland Ice Sheet could raise sea levels by 7.4 meters
questions.explanation: Text 1 states that 'The Greenland Ice Sheet, containing enough water to raise global sea levels by 7.4 meters if completely melted...'

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?

questions.correctAnswer: Summer sea ice reached its lowest recorded extent in 2012
questions.explanation: Text 1 states that 'Summer sea ice extent reached a record low in September 2012...'

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
